newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close on highs after Ericsson rises.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close on highs after Ericsson rises.

text.p: Sweden's sharemarket closed at another new high on Wednesday, after market heavyweight Ericsson reversed from early losses and with support from other European bourses.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.32 percent to 3,010.18 in light turnover of 3.61 billion crowns.
"It has been a really boring day and it is only the U.S. market coming in that raised the pace in the afternoon," one broker said.
Telecoms major Ericsson started the day lower after losses in the U.S. overnight but closed one higher at 305.5 crowns.
